summary: Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a regular monthly distribution and an interim NAV update. The board declared a $0.1600 gross per-share distribution across Class I, D, S and T shares, net of servicing fees for D/S/T, payable September 28, 2026 to holders of record and paid on or about October 28, 2026, in cash or via reinvestment. NAV per share was $22.32 as of August 31, 2026, against roughly $4.3 billion aggregate NAV, $6.8 billion portfolio fair value and 0.58x net leverage. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; the continuous $5.0 billion offering continues.
